meta.name: Khemjira
meta.description: With a deadly curse set to claim him at 21, a young man flees to a master of ancient magic—only to face ghosts more dangerous than his fate.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As spirits around Khem become increasingly hostile, his friend Jet seeks help from Master Pharan.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Master Pharan battles vengeful spirits as Khemjira faces Rumphueng’s curse and a strange possession.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Past-life love and betrayal resurface as Master Pharan battles spirits to save the missing.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ghost Chayod lures Khemjira with past-life ties, while Por Kru races to save him and resist helping.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Pharan battles Ramphueng’s vengeful spirit as Khem, Chan, and Jett face trials of loyalty and fate.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Pharan’s painful past resurfaces as Khemjira faces eerie rituals, while Prima’s family stirs new tensions.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: At a ritual play and temple fair, Khemjira and P’Phong are ensnared by a rival’s deadly dark spell.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A ritual unveils past-life secrets and a clue to ending the deadly curse haunting Khemjira.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Rampheung's vengeful spirit strikes again, forcing Khemjira to rely on allies and old secrets to survive.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As Khemjira faces a deadly countdown to his 21st birthday, dark forces close in with no escape.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Porkru Pharan leads a daring mission to face Ghost Ramphueng—one last battle for Khemjira’s life.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Khemjira faces his final battle against Ramphueng as dawn decides whether he lives or dies.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: As Khem prepares to marry Pharan, a mysterious disappearance draws his fiancé into danger deep in the forest.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Pharan searches for missing people in a haunted forest, Khem faces a supernatural crisis of his own.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While Khem and Pharan celebrate their new life, distance and misunderstandings threaten Jet and Charn’s relationship.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As friends gather for Jet and Charn’s wedding, Khem looks back on the love and choices that brought them together.
